adjudication.family_description: Money flows both ways with the same party and reference: a supplier refund beside the payment of its bill; a customer refund beside the customer's payment.

adjudication.label_reason: The outgoing Faster Payment quotes the bill; the same-week £120.00 credit from the supplier quoting the same bill is a refund (wrong direction for a bill) and is remaining work.
